name: The Mirage
author: Schnuck01
style: Terraced hillside modern on a lake: a fieldstone plinth lifts the main floor, loggia and pool terrace a storey above a jungle bank and lily pond; a glass stair tower with stone piers, a bedroom floor cantilevered over the loggia on walnut fascias, a dark-timber clerestory, an olive lap-siding den and a pale stucco entry block
